subject: 山庄 / 大院
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Material and object replacement only, ABSOLUTELY KEEP EXACT reference contour, composition and isometric camera. Preserve all four ground corners, all wall-base lines, roof lines, and gate location. Turn this compound into a Southern Song domestic wealthy manor: remove cargo cart, cargo boxes, crates and bags; make courtyard warm stone paths with one leafy broadleaf tree in middle and a few bamboo clumps by the rear; rear and side structures become residential rooms with timber lattices. Do not add new wings, do not widen/deepen/rotate existing compound. All massing and the entire rectangular base must remain identical to reference. Same natural muted grey clay tile, weathered brown wood, cream plaster and stone. Upper-left light, short down-right shadow. The correct reference ground axes have slopes+.5/- .5, preserve them. Footprint16x13 logical cells, existing shape is already within tolerance so don't change shape. Output true RGBA transparent background with10% margin and full eaves. No text, numbers, symbols, watermark, people, modern items, fancy imperial roof decorations. Same physical shape, solely furnishings/landscaping/use change.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

references.role: 本轮未获审批候选，投影/材质参考

created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 第2次运行返修：内置image_gen真实重出主体；逐张view_image及64×32占地叠图，宽深关系和两轴目视协调，左上光、暖灰瓦木石、宋意象，无文字人物现代物；无裁切。严格几何数值见geometry_qa；不将轻微告警当成已通过。
